title: Samson and Delilah Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Samson and Delilah Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Samson and Delilah Bible crossword: the Nazarite vow, the lion, the jawbone, and the pillars at Gaza. KJV clues from Judges, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: A child promised to a barren woman, raised a Nazarite with a razor never coming on his head, and given strength that made no sense. Samson and Delilah works through Judges 13–16 — the lion rent as a kid, the riddle at the wedding feast, the foxes, the jawbone of an ass, and the woman in the valley of Sorek who asked him one question four times.
It ends in Gaza, between two pillars, with his hair grown again. The closing verse is right at the start, where the child is born and the LORD blesses him.

clues.text: Woman of the valley of Sorek
Beast he rent as he would have rent a kid
City where he bowed himself between the pillars

verseText: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
